parameters.query:
SELECT 
  sa.title,
  sa.url,
  sa.description,
  sa.source,
  sa.category,
  sa.severity,
  sa.created_at
FROM security_aggregations sa
WHERE sa.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours'
  AND (sa.severity = 'critical' OR sa.severity = 'high')
ORDER BY sa.severity DESC, sa.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT title, url, description, category, severity, created_at
FROM security_aggregations
WHERE title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR description ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
